text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! It's Make Debut time-desu! The day 
has finally come, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A super rookie taking flight across the 
world is born! Explosively born! Dandan 
noodles, dess!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Dandan noodles are spicy, but 
they are NOT Mexican food~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us go. To the paddock, 
where the international media is swarming 
with keen interest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back! Give it everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, so many of our classmates have 
come to watch, too, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still... quoi? What about the overseas 
media?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, we have a huge problem-desu! The 
man in sunglasses holding a ballpoint pen 
in his mouth is nowhere to be found-desu!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Did something happen? Aren't you going to 
stay and watch El's debut match?!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
choice_data_list:
Even so, expecting that much attention 
from your debut is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What?! She is no ordinary rookie, you 
know?! Is the whole world blind, yes?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And this race was supposed to be the 
beginning of the El El legend, too...!"
choice_data_list:
Still, the footage is going to be 
broadcast worldwide...

text_block_list.text:
The URA is live streaming the race online. 
When I told her that an outstanding run 
would catch people's attention—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, is that so, yes! That is a relief, 
yes. Even from my home country, I will get 
to witness history in the making!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's gonna do it! Talent! Motivation! 
Running! I'll show you something 
completely outrageous in every way!
